title: quassia baileyana
intro: Quassia baileyana, commonly known as Yellow Dogwood or simply Quassia, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, such as its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial agent, which can help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Quassia baileyana include its use as a stimulant, expectorant, and anti-parasitic agent, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and parasitic infections. The bioactive constituents of Quassia baileyana include alkaloids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its various health benefits.
